ratio_faq_default.title: Frequently Asked Questions
ratio_faq_default.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we hear most often. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.

sections.heading: How long will my order take to arrive?
sections.body: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery then takes 3–7 business days, while express delivery takes 1–3 business days.

sections.heading: How do I track my order?
sections.body: Once your order ships, we'll email you a tracking number and link so you can follow your package in real time.

sections.heading: What is your return policy?
sections.body: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, provided they're unused and in their original packaging. See our Refund & Return Policy for full details.

sections.heading: Can I change or cancel my order?
sections.body: If your order hasn't shipped yet, contact us as soon as possible and we'll do our best to update or cancel it.

sections.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
sections.body: We accept all major credit and debit cards, along with the popular digital payment methods shown at checkout.

sections.heading: Do you ship internationally?
sections.body: Where international shipping is available, it will be shown at checkout. Any customs duties or taxes are the responsibility of the recipient.

sections.heading: How do I contact customer support?
sections.body: You can reach us through our Contact page by email or phone during our support hours. We usually respond within one business day.
